parameters.confirmationDeadlineHelp: How many days before the collection the customer can confirm. Without confirmation by the deadline, the request leaves the route.
parameters.qrThresholdHelp: Extra percentage of QR codes generated over the bags reported when starting the route (e.g. 10% → 3 bags generate 4 codes).
parameters.labelSectionHelp: Size of the label roll used to print the bag QR codes: it defines the page, one label per page. Select the label printer in the print dialog.
parameters.labelQrSizeHelp: The QR sits on the left with the code beside it. A bigger QR reads from further away — but it has to fit the label, with a 2 mm margin.
parameters.labelRotationHelp: If the content comes out sideways or upside down on the label, rotate it here. The print direction depends on the model and how the roll is loaded.
parameters.routesSectionHelp: Start and end point of routes and time spent at each pickup. Used to compute km and the expected time at each stop in "New route".
parameters.warehouseNoCoords: No coordinates: type the address and press "Locate".
parameters.stopTimeHelp: E.g. 5 + 1 per bag → a 4-bag pickup counts 9 minutes.
